name: government-tenders-api
title: Government Tenders API — Global Public Procurement Data
description: Public tenders and contract awards from 40+ countries in one feed: EU TED, US SAM.gov, UK Find a Tender & Contracts Finder, Australia, Canada, Brazil and more. Filter by keyword, CPV/NAICS, country, value, deadline. $3.50 per 1,000 notices.

notice_id.description: Stable notice ID, '<source>:<source id>' (ted:792825-2026, sam:<NoticeId>, uk-fts:<notice id>, uk-cf:<release id>, ocds-<country>:<ocid>). Same notice, same ID on every run

source.description: Source of the notice: ted (EU Tenders Electronic Daily), sam (US SAM.gov), uk-fts (UK Find a Tender), uk-cf (UK Contracts Finder) or ocds-<country> (a national platform's open data via the Open Contracting Data Registry, e.g. ocds-au, ocds-de)

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the buying authority (for national platforms: the platform's country)

buyer_name.description: Name of the contracting authority or buyer as published (an organisation, never a person). SAM.gov: department · sub-tier · office

buyer_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code from the buyer's address, when published

title.description: Notice title as published (TED: the English title 'Country – CPV label – original title'), max 300 characters

description_snippet.description: First 500 characters of the notice's description, whitespace collapsed; e-mail addresses and phone numbers replaced by [email redacted] / [phone redacted]

notice_type.description: planning (prior information, sources sought), tender (call for tender, solicitation), award (contract award), contract (contract signed or modified), cancellation, other

procedure_type.description: Procurement procedure as the source states it (open, restricted, negotiated with call, Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, Request for Bid...)

status.description: open (deadline in the future at run time), closed (deadline passed), awarded (award or contract notice), cancelled, unknown (no deadline published)

cpv_codes.description: EU Common Procurement Vocabulary codes (8 digits) of the notice; empty when the source uses none

naics_codes.description: US NAICS codes (SAM.gov notices); empty elsewhere

unspsc_codes.description: UNSPSC product codes where the source publishes them (several Latin American platforms); empty elsewhere

value_amount.description: Value in value_currency: the awarded value for award/contract notices, else the estimated value; null when not published

value_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of value_amount (EUR, USD, GBP...)

published_at.description: When the notice was published (ISO 8601, UTC; date-only sources at 00:00Z). For national-platform records: the date of the stage shown (award date for awards, tender publication otherwise)

deadline_at.description: Deadline for tenders / requests to participate (ISO 8601, UTC; TED publishes the date only, counted until 23:59:59Z); null for awards and when not published

award_date.description: Date of the award decision for award and contract notices (ISO 8601, UTC)

supplier_names.description: Awarded suppliers, organisations only: v1 lists a supplier only when it carries a company or charity register number (UK Companies House, charity registers). Empty for other sources, so no sole trader or natural person is ever listed

language.description: 2-letter language code of the notice text

notice_url.description: Public web page of the notice on the source platform; null when the platform's open data has no page link

source_url.description: The API, extract or open-data file the notice was read from

fetched_at.description: When the nightly index first read this notice (ISO 8601, UTC); the key of sinceLastRun
